articles.summary: Agreement Removes Fixed Expiration Date and Requires 48 Months’ Advance Notice to Terminate, Providing a Minimum Four-Year Term at All Times ST. PETERSBURG, Fla., Sept. 14, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) - American Coastal Insurance Corporation (Nasdaq Ticker: ACIC) (“the Company”, “American Coastal” or “ACIC”), the insurance holding company of American Coastal Insurance Company (“AmCoastal”), announced today that AmCoastal and AmRisc, LLC (“AmRisc”) have restructured their exclusive managing agency agreement, effective July 1, 2026, to remove the agreement’s fixed expiration date. The prior agreement, extended in June 2024, was scheduled to expire on January 1, 2029. The restructured agreement provides for successive one-year terms that automatically renew, and requires either party to provide 48 months’ advance written notice in order to terminate the agreement for convenience, with the agreement remaining in full force and effect through the notice period.
